title: Crows Never Forget a Face
description: Crows can recognize individual human faces and remember people who treated them badly for years.

scenes.text: Crows can recognize your face, and they can remember it for years.
In one famous study in Seattle, researchers wore a mask while they caught and tagged crows.
Years later, crows still scolded and dive bombed anyone who wore that same mask.
Even crows that were never caught joined in. They seemed to learn who to dislike from the others.
So be kind to the crows. They are watching. Follow for more weird facts.
